risk_summary: The disclosure is highly detailed and quantified regarding the merger, divestiture, consideration mechanics, and tax valuation allowance, but relies on optimistic, unverified claims about the dry battery electrode technology and future growth. The divested high-voltage product line represented 20% of 2018 revenue and 49% of gross profit, highlighting material business contraction and concentration risk. A full valuation allowance against $67.0 million of deferred tax assets also signals uncertainty regarding future taxable income and asset realization.
